name: brainbox
description: BrainBox 0.1.0: written clean from the research rather than patched. The brain a new owner gets is now a set of real files, not text buried in a script. The rule book is short and holds only what must always be true. The rules that can be checks are checks that run on their own - deleting the owner's work is blocked, new files are checked for an opening line and a catalogue entry, and every session opens by saying where things are up to. Four routines: catch me up, find, check the brain, wrap up. About me has eleven blanks, including what's in my way.
